pr_title: Improved UI error messages when the parameter must be a constant
pr_body:
Closes #68324.

Improved UI error messages when the parameter must be a constant. In order to propose a new message, i've looked into Elasticsearch UI errors Guidelines and then, did some research and analysed the UX Guidelines to write effective error messages.

This change improves usability, since a good error message has three parts: Problem identification, cause details if helpful, and a solution if possible. I would appreciate if someone could give me some feedback.
pr_comments: I've tagged @stu-elastic to have a look at this because I'm going to be away from my laptop all of next week.
@andrevpessanha is there any progress on @nik9000 suggestion?
Hi @stu-elastic, I've just updated the method that converts int to ordinal number and implemented the code my way. I believe there is no more copyright issues.

Unfortunately we don't seem to be making progress towards merging. There are still review comments which are unaddressed after the comments highlighting them. We are not able to merge this pull request without those changes being addressed.

We really appreciate your interest in contributing to Elasticsearch and hope you make more contributions in the future, however in this case we have taken the decision to close this pull request. You can read more about our approach to reviewing and accepting contributions in our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reviewing-and-accepting-your-contribution).

issue_context.title: Painless: improve error message when parameter must be a constant but isn't
issue_context.body:
Now the error message is:
```
"all arguments must be constant but the [2] argument isn't
```

That isn't really even English. I mean, it tells you where to look and we don't have any better ideas given the infrastructure we have, but we do need to make it better.
comments: Yes this message should be better.  @nik9000 can you provide a brief script illustrating the problem?
Hi, can I check this out? First time contributing
Hi @nik9000, i opened a PR to solve this issue and since this is my first contribution, i'd be really glad if you could give me some feedback.
Hi @nik9000, could you tell me what do you think of these new error messages? I had mapped four occurrences of this type of error, but please let me know if i forgot to update any other messages.

Could I jump on this issue? 

I'm going to optimize the error message to:

```
All arguments of the [<methodName>] method must be constants, 
but the argument [<argumentName>] is not
```
Hi @stu-elastic, could you please review my changes in #82638
